svg.text: 2026-11-23 Night Round 33 (🏆 R820 Milestone) · 37Studio + Jeveration + EMA-Lightning + RabbitWall
AI Video Studio & Social Publishing · 78 ms Single-Pass VLM Image Generation · 8.6M Offline TTS · Dual-NIC AI Egress Gateway
1. Shaitrish/37studio (★ 170 · 25 forks · Go · MIT)
Open-Source AI Video Studio, 9-Platform Publisher & Comment Responder
• Editor Agent: Brief a reel, ad, or explainer in your brand library and render locally
• Multi-Platform Social Ops: Posts directly to 9 platforms and drafts comment replies
• BYOK Zero-Subscription Stack: Replaces Opus Clip, Buffer, and Claude Motion
• Runs on Windows, Linux, macOS & server · CLI + AI agent skill ready
2. Carol-lyh/Jeveration (★ 146 · 12 forks · Python · Apache-2.0)
78 ms Single-Forward-Pass Frozen VLM Image Generation & Dense Prediction
• Joint Decision VLM: Returns 512x512 image in 1 forward pass (78 ms on 1x H200)
• Unified Checkpoint: Text-to-image, image-to-image (hed/depth/colorize/style)
• Dense Prediction: Segmentation, depth, and surface normals on Qwen3.5-4B
• TA-TiTok tokenizer + CLIP text tower · 6.5 GB weights via Hugging Face
3. canberk7/ema-lightning (★ 308 · 35 forks · Python · Apache-2.0)
8.6M-Param Offline Turkish TTS with 4 ms First Audio & Playhead Scheduler
• State-of-the-Art Accuracy: 0.92% WER on Freya-TR-Eval (495 sentences, ~34 MB)
• Ultra-Low Latency: ~4 ms first audio, 440x real-time single & 1,316x batched
• Built-In Playhead Scheduler: Thread-safe multi-caller GPU batching or CPU-only
• Native normalization for numbers, dates, money, units & symbols (~$0.0085/1M chars)
4. ysuito/RabbitWall (★ 68 · 11 forks · Python · MIT)
Dual-NIC Linux AI Network Egress Gateway & mTLS Traffic Console
• Hard Egress Switch: Instant cutoff of established connections & DNS for AI hosts
• Time-Boxed Domain Approvals: Approve exact domains per node for 1, 5, or 30 min
• Zero-Trust Console: Source-IP filtering + Caddy client-certificate mTLS auth
• Live world map, route list, newly observed domain alerts & 1h/24h traffic ranking
Closed-Form FinOps TCO Verification (R820 Milestone · 37Studio + Jeveration + EMA-Lightning + RabbitWall)
• Path A (Commercial Video Clip/Publish SaaS + Diffusion API + Cloud TTS + Managed Firewall): $4,980.00 SaaS/API + $4,500.00 labor (45.0h @ $100/h) = $9,480.00/mo
• Path C (Self-Hosted 37Studio + Jeveration + EMA-Lightning + RabbitWall): $65.00 compute + $240.00 labor (2.4h @ $100/h) = $305.00/mo · Net Savings $9,175.00/mo (-96.78%)
